_meta.dataset: Line-by-Line Primary-Source Hotel Verification, NYC Tax Audit & Feb–Mar 2027 Booking Window Analysis

nyc_hotel_tax_official.authority: NYC Department of Finance — Hotel Room Occupancy Tax
nyc_hotel_tax_official.percentage_components: 5.875% NYC Hotel Room Occupancy Tax + 8.875% Combined NYS/NYC/MCTD Sales Tax = 14.75%
nyc_hotel_tax_official.flat_fee_components: $2.00/day/room NYC room fee (for rooms $40+/night; multi-room suites pay $2.00 per room) + $1.50/unit/day NYS Javits Center Hotel Unit Fee = $3.50/night for a standard 1-room unit
nyc_hotel_tax_official.repo_irregularity_note: Existing data/hotels.json and pages/findings.html describe a '$4/night city tax' ($28 for 7 nights). Official NYC Department of Finance rules set the statutory single-room flat fees at $3.50/night ($24.50 for 7 nights), though 2-room suites ($2.00 x 2 + $1.50 = $5.50/night) or property-specific BID assessments can differ.

booking_window_findings.date_conflict_flag: Feb 15–18, 2027 (Mon–Thu) is 3 nights, whereas the trip brief also requests a 1–2 week stay and a 7-night total hotel price. Feb 15, 2027 is Presidents' Day (federal holiday) and NYC public schools Midwinter Recess week.

booking_window_findings.seasonal_rate_status: UNVERIFIED across full Feb 15–Mar 23, 2027 calendar — only one 7-night window (15–22 Feb 2027) was captured on Booking.com on 2026-11-25. Historically late Jan–late Feb (excluding Presidents' Day weekend) is winter low season before mid-March spring-break compression, so checking 22 Feb–1 Mar 2027 and 1–8 Mar 2027 directly on official engines before Dec 3 / Dec 8, 2026 promo cutoffs is the highest-leverage next step.
